arm_plant: fitted UMArm pneumatic MuJoCo twin at 150 Hz with 1 kHz physics/contact integration
contact_model: free nominal-25 g, 18 mm sphere against a rigidly mounted open three-finger gripper; Stage 5 varies mass from 20-35 g

gripper.opening: faces the launcher on the negative world-y side; local +z follows nominal incoming direction [0,+1,-0.75]

grasp.closed_state: runtime MuJoCo weld at the measured relative pose

launch.travel_direction: positive world-y with impact slope sampled around the catcher aperture axis
launch.ballistics: flight time and initial velocity are solved so the free ball reaches the sampled intercept with a trackable aperture-aligned impact direction

controller.ppo_action: intercept offset, phase velocity adjustment, directional compliance, follow-through duration, release flight time
controller.approach_reference: cubic Hermite rendezvous with consistent position and velocity and the ballistic impact velocity as terminal state
controller.collision_aware_observation: gravity-aware gripper-frame entry xyz, time to entry, entry radial error, and piecewise-ballistic swept-capsule first-contact radial error

target.type: fixed spherical region in MuJoCo world frame
target.height: same nominal height as the home gripper
target.success: released physical ball enters the target region

curriculum.advance_rule: only at PPO update boundaries; at least 20 updates at the current difficulty and 80 percent deterministic held-out success
curriculum.evaluation: 20 fixed-seed deterministic episodes every 10 PPO updates
curriculum.stage_1: 0.85-1.05 m aperture-aligned launch with a 10-25 mm offset grasp
curriculum.stage_2: 0.78-1.10 m launch through sublevels A/B/C with increasing position and velocity disturbances
curriculum.stage_3: 0.90-1.10 m launch, broader approach geometry, continuous follow-through and release
curriculum.stage_4: 1.00-1.25 m launch, broader disturbances, release into a broad far-side target
curriculum.stage_5: 1.10-1.40 m launch, full position/speed/mass distribution, 60 mm target, strict grasp, force and energy objective

pregrasp_reward.geometry: radial position at the gripper entry plane plus earliest swept-sphere collision against three finger capsules and the palm face
pregrasp_reward.rendezvous_shaping: before first contact, reward progress and low error against the nominal cubic position and velocity state; after contact use measured relative velocity and alignment
pregrasp_reward.invalid_contact_penalty: squared excess for radial, axial, relative-speed, and alignment grasp gates
pregrasp_reward.velocity_match_gating: enabled only near a geometrically valid predicted contact

soft_quality_targets.purpose: dense reward and diagnostics target for soft-catch quality; does not relax the physical grasp gate and does not block full-curriculum probing

energy.online_metric: absolute muscle boundary work plus explicit assumed finger open/close energy
energy.not_claimed: electrical compressor or supply energy until valve mass-flow and efficiency calibration
